task: Preserve the exact parent Completion Truth / persistence failure cause through Release Unit Execution so fail-closed parent blockers are self-diagnosing.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Immutable rehearsal Release Unit Execution #260 closed U03 successfully and advanced the canonical parent state to TRUTH_GATE with closureEligible=true, but then returned the generic blocker RELEASE_PARENT_PROOF_OR_PERSISTENCE_FAILED. closeParentReleaseExecution already captures the underlying exception text in result.error, while the driver serializes result.reason before result.error and therefore discards the exact machine cause. This prevents the Gate Hardening rule that blockers directly expose the precise failure from being satisfied and blocks root-cause repair without log/code archaeology.
observableOutcomes: Parent proof/persistence failures return a structured fail-closed reason containing code RELEASE_PARENT_PROOF_OR_PERSISTENCE_FAILED and the exact underlying error text in details.error.
release-unit-execute serializes the structured reason without losing details.
